summary:
Reproduced SAM 2 paper with complete model architecture, training pipeline, evaluation, and data utilities:

**Model Components:**
- HieraImageEncoder: Hierarchical vision transformer with FPN fusion of stride 16+32 features, skip connections from stride 4+8
- MemoryAttention: L=4 transformer blocks with self-attention (2D-RoPE) + cross-attention to memory + MLP
- MemoryBank: FIFO queues for N=6 recent frames (with temporal pos embed) and M prompted frames (without), plus object pointers
- MemoryEncoder: Mask downsampling + image embedding fusion → 64-dim memory features
- MaskDecoder: Two-way transformer with occlusion prediction head, skip connections from image encoder, multi-mask output
- PromptEncoder: Identical to SAM (clicks, boxes, masks)
- Full SAM2 model with streaming video processing

**Training:**
- Pre-training on SA-1B (90k steps, batch 256, 1024²)
- Full training on mixed data (200k steps, batch 128, 8-frame sequences)
- Fine-tuning (50k steps, 16-frame sequences on most-edited masklets)
- Interactive prompt sampler (mask/click/box initial prompts, correction clicks, mosaic, reversal)
- Losses: Focal+Dice (20:1) + L1 IoU + CE object presence
- AdamW with reciprocal sqrt LR schedule, layer-wise decay

**Evaluation:**
- Semi-supervised VOS, interactive offline/online, image segmentation
- J&F and mIoU metrics

**Data:**
- Data engine specification (3 phases)
- SA-V dataset statistics
- Data augmentations (hflip, affine, jitter, grayscale, mosaic)
- All hyperparameters from Table 12
